title: Huracán Beats River Plate with Goals from Blondel and Cortés
seoTitle: Huracán defeats River Plate; Blondel, Cortés score
subtitle: Decisive Goals and Injuries to Almada and Andrada Mark Match
excerpt: In a clash from the tenth matchday of Torneo Clausura's Zone B, Huracán secured a crucial three points against River Plate, with goals by Óscar Cortés and Lucas.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
In a clash from the tenth matchday of Torneo Clausura's Zone B, Huracán secured a crucial three points against River Plate, with goals by Óscar Cortés and Lucas Blondel. Injuries to Thiago Almada and Tobías Andrada turned the game into a nightmare for the Millonario.

Blondel's Goal Secures Huracán's Victory

Right-back Lucas Blondel, on loan at Parque Patricios until December this year, scored Huracán's second goal with a shot from outside the box, leaving goalkeeper Santiago Beltrán with no chance. The goal, scored 22 minutes into the game, was Blondel's second in 22 appearances for the club.

Cortés Opens Scoring with Precise Free Kick

Óscar Cortés of Huracán opened the scoring with a free kick that surprised River Plate's goalkeeper. The game's very first play already showcased the visiting team's determination.

River Plate Suffers with Injuries to Almada and Andrada

Thiago Almada left the field before the end of the first half due to a severe muscle discomfort. Subsequently, Tobías Andrada exited in tears due to intense pain in his right hamstring. Both departures alarmed River Plate's coach and the medical staff of the Argentine National Team.

River Plate Tries to React, but Huracán Maintains Lead

River Plate managed a temporary equalizer through Tomás Galván, but could not turn the game around. Huracán maintained their advantage with Blondel's performance, who finished the match with a powerful shot.

Impact on the Argentine National Team and the Torneo Clausura

The injuries to Almada and Andrada generated medical concern for the Argentine national team, as both are part of Lionel Scaloni's squad list for the upcoming triple FIFA international window. The result also impacts River Plate's position in the Torneo Clausura Zone B table.

With information from TyC Sports, OneFootball.
